description:
You are a mechanical engineer working on a tenant improvement project. The 'Ground Floor East' office space in the 4StoreyBuilding is being converted into a specialized quality control laboratory. This requires tighter temperature control and 100% outside air ventilation for safety.

Your task is to update the eQUEST model:
1. Navigate to the Air-Side HVAC system parameters.
2. Locate the Ground Floor East zone (look for 'G.East Perim Zn' or similar under the Ground Floor systems).
3. Change the zone's Throttling Range (deadband) to 0.5°F (currently default).
4. Change the zone's Outside Air (OA) Flow/Area to 1.0 CFM/ft².
5. Run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to validate the changes.
6. Save the project.

Do not apply these changes to other zones.
